t: A free open source mapping program for making and analyzing maps.
steps: Find QGIS on its official site and open the download page.
Ask IT to approve the install on managed computers.
Choose between the regular build and the Long Term Release build.
Install QGIS on a test computer.
Open the QGIS tutorials and training manual.
Load a sample data layer and make a simple map.
Try one short lesson with a small group first.
